Subject: Estimate + next steps — confirm receipt and 15m walkthrough?

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- Scope: pilot inference for OrchID search assistant (1 model endpoint, batching + KV cache)
- Target traffic: ~20 qps peak with 1.5s SLO for tail latency
- Value priorities: latency under 1s for short queries, cost predictability for support tier

Attached is the estimate we discussed plus a short pricing deck. Highlights:
- Baseline monthly committed capacity estimate and optional burst pools
- Suggested quantization and batching profile to reach target cost per 1M tokens
- Recommended rollout: 1-month proof-of-value → scale to reserved in month 3

Attachments: [Redwood_Estimate_OrchidAI_v1.pdf (pdf)], [Redwood_Pricing_Deck.pdf (pdf)]

Would you mind confirming you received both files? Happy to walk through the assumptions in 15 minutes — I can do early next week. 

Proposed 15-min slots (PT): Mon 9/21 10:00, Tue 9/22 11:30, Wed 9/23 14:00. If none work, tell me two windows that do and I will send a calendar invite.

Also looping in Monica (solutions engineering) for any technical follow-ups on the KV caching and autoscaling plan.

Thanks,
Mateo
